properties.Observation: The total length of canal is 1Km. Although some parts of the canal have been concreted exist remains as a earthen canal. 5 Acres of paddy is cultivated from this canal. Leakages are observed (along the canal). Canal bund has been encroached at some places therefore farmers requested to strengthen the bund and demacate the reservation by planting Aricanut trees.
